name: BBC-Bench-Raw-Data
description: A raw data collection derived from BBC content intended to support downstream NLP tasks such as topic classification, summarization, and question answering. The dataset provides unprocessed articles and associated metadata for use in building and evaluating text models. It is presented as a general-purpose text corpus for benchmarking models on news-related language tasks.
reputation: A small, domain-specific news corpus with modest community usage mainly for news/topic modelling and baseline evaluations.
